target_customer: Independent filmmakers and short film viewers; later brands and creators monetizing video
problem: Short films have little distribution and monetization. Argo streams festival-curated shorts, shares revenue with filmmakers and offered NFT collections of films.
business_model: Streaming platform with revenue share to filmmakers, plus NFT sales
product_category: Short film streaming and social platform

founders.name: Arcadiy Golubovich
education: University of the Arts London Central Saint Martins, BA, 2008
founders.background_notes: YC page says he works in film production and VC media tech in Los Angeles. Prior employers not named.

technical_complexity.rationale: A video streaming app with curation and an NFT mint layer used standard components in 2021.

defensibility.rationale: Content depends on festival licensing and filmmaker deals that others can replicate. No network effect shown.

market_need_then: Filmmakers lacked monetization for shorts, and the 2021 NFT wave created interest in new film funding models, per the Film Fund blog dated December 2021.

branding.domain_note: Uses argo.la and watchargo.com rather than argo.com.
branding.community_and_virality: Coverage in No Film School (January 2021) and a documentary.org post on shorts available on Argo.

brand_strength.rationale: Some film press coverage but a name shared with many unrelated companies, and no brand story found.

pivots.from: Global short film streaming platform with film NFTs
pivots.to: Social streaming platform for brands and creators to monetize video and reward fans
pivots.why: not stated; inferred only from the change between the March 2022 press release and the current YC description

outcome_analysis: Argo joined YC W22 with a reported $500K YC investment and a short film streaming and NFT pitch, then broadened its description to brands and creators. YC lists it Active with ten staff but no jobs. No follow-on funding was verified, and a 2023 Wefunder listing showed a $27M cap SAFE that was marked not funded. The story is unclear and no outcome evidence was found.
notes: argo.la returned 404 when fetched. CB Insights reports $500K over 3 rounds and Seedtable lists a $125K seed in April 2022; these conflict and are unverified aggregator figures. Competitors: a search found short-film services Klipist and FILMPIXS but no source dated near early 2022, so the list is left empty. Many unrelated companies named Argo exist. Pivot is inferred from description change and flagged as such.
